text: The findings support a multifactorial understanding of migrant mental health, highlighting the combined influence of pre-migration adversities, migration-related experiences and post-migration conditions. Interventions targeting modifiable factors, particularly acculturative stress, perceived discrimination, and quality of life, may contribute to improving mental health among migrant populations.
source_label: A multifactorial model of factors associated with PTSD, anxiety and depression among migrants in Spain
